claims.text: AAPA: the American Academy of Physician Associates, founded in 1968, is the national professional society for PAs.
claims.quote: Founded in 1968, the American Academy of Physician Associates is the national professional society for PAs (physician associates/physician assistants).

claims.text: NCCPA: the National Commission on Certification of Physician Assistants runs PANCE and certification.
claims.quote: Through the National Commission on Certification of Physician Assistants (NCCPA), aspiring PAs complete the Physician Assistant National Certifying Examination (PANCE) after graduating from an accredited PA program.

claims.text: ARC-PA: accredits the entry-level PA programs whose graduates may take PANCE.
claims.quote: To be eligible for PANCE, you must graduate from an entry-level PA program accredited by ARC-PA.
claims.locator: Who is eligible to apply for PANCE?

claims.text: PAEA: the PA Education Association is the only national organization representing PA educational programs.
claims.quote: The PA Education Association (PAEA) is the only national organization representing PA educational programs.
